ABC News live updates, last updated 23 Nov 2026 4:38 AM EST (09:38 GMT) (extracted via fetch tool)
Monday 23 Nov: Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei said Hormuz security could be restored quickly if the US meets Iran's conditions. Security "can be restored to the Strait of Hormuz and the region in the shortest possible time" if the US fulfils its commitments. Iran "will under no circumstances back down on this matter." Iran's conditions include removing "cruel and unlawful sanctions," lifting the US naval blockade, and implementing the June memorandum.
Talks remain stalled despite a June memorandum of understanding meant to end the war, which began with joint US-Israeli strikes in February that killed Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. The US says it is enforcing a naval blockade of Iranian Persian Gulf and Gulf of Oman ports; Iran claims control of the Strait of Hormuz.
22 Nov 5:42 AM EST: IRGC claimed to have shot down a US MQ-1 Predator drone east of the Strait of Hormuz; CENTCOM no comment.
22 Nov 7:34 AM EST: Saudi Arabia, Kuwait and Qatar condemned Iran's Saturday attack on Bahrain (two injured, fire at a civilian industrial facility). Qatar: a "flagrant violation of its sovereignty and territorial integrity." Saudi Arabia: "heinous."
22 Nov 12:47 PM EST: UKMTO reported an incident "involving a tanker and military forces in the Gulf of Oman." IRGC navy said two tankers exploded after hitting sea mines near Ghanem Island, claiming they used "unauthorized routes."
Background: Yemeni government forces and Houthi rebels have intensified fighting; Houthis repeatedly attacking Saudi military, oil and transport sites.
